title: Valid Palindrome II
summary: Decide whether deleting zero or one character can leave a string that reads identically from either direction.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned bool.

statement: Decide whether deleting zero or one character can leave a string that reads identically from either direction.

examples.explanation: Every one-character deletion still leaves a mismatch.

hints: Conceptual: Most mirrored character pairs need no change.
Directional: At the first mismatch, consider which endpoint could be removed.
Implementation: Test the remaining interval after skipping the left endpoint and after skipping the right endpoint. Neither test may delete again.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
